Last Frontier

About Last Frontier

Defend your base in a 3D real-time strategy battle. Build barracks, factories and towers, train infantry, tanks, artillery and aircraft, and lead your commander into the fight. Each building pad is upgraded by running your commander onto it. Factions: Modern Army, Musketeers, Pirates, Elves and Orcs, each with its own units, buildings and commander. Modes: a 10-chapter campaign and endless Survival with ever-growing waves and bosses. Earn medals to unlock factions, harder difficulty and permanent upgrades.

How to play

Controls joystick or WASD arrows to move the commander tap click buttons to build and train special ability button for the commanders ultimate
